main.description: Merchant-side mirror of one non-current storefront signing key (a keyHistory entry of the appDid DID document). One record per retired or revoked key, rkey = the bare kid fragment (e.g. merchant-key-2026-04-17). Written to the merchant's own PDS so a verifier can check the merchant's historical purchase records without a separate /.well-known/did.json fetch. The DID document is authoritative: if a mirror record disagrees with the live document, the document wins. Bazaar prompts the merchant to (re)synchronize this collection from the merchant panel after a key rotation.

appDid.description: The Bazaar storefront DID (a did:web) this key belongs to.

id.description: Full DID URL of the key, e.g. did:web:bazaar.whereditgo.diamonds#merchant-key-2026-04-17. The fragment equals this record's rkey.

controller.description: The storefront DID that controls this key (equals appDid).

publicKeyMultibase.description: Multibase (z...) encoding of the P-256 public key, per the Multikey / did:key convention.

supersededBy.description: Full DID URL of the key that became current after this one.

revoked.description: True = hard-revoked: signatures made by this key are rejected outright. Absent = retired but still trusted for records it signed before rotation.

syncedAt.description: When the merchant last wrote this mirror record.
